{{Quote|A Taung blood duel will resolve this dispute. A duel to the death. Challenge Sedyn. A true Mandalorian must accept.|[[Hedarr Soongh]]|<ref name="TOR:HR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Honor Regained|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
A '''Taung blood duel''' was an ancient [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] tradition that originated with the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and saw two combatants duel to the death to resolve matters of honor.<ref name="TOR:HR" />

When in need of settling a matter of honor, the legendary [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] champion [[Hedarr Soongh]], made the [[Hunter (individual)|young hunter]] and the dishonorable Mandalorian [[Sedyn Kyne]] face each other in this duel.<ref name="TOR:HR" />
